items.question: Which file formats can be imported into the knowledge base?
items.answer: Markdown, plain text, CSV, JSON, PDF, and DOCX are accepted by the ingestion workflow. PDF and DOCX are converted to text before indexing.

items.question: How are duplicated imported articles handled?
items.answer: The importer checks title, canonical URL, and source_id. Exact duplicates are skipped. Similar articles are flagged for review.

items.question: Can conversation exports include internal notes?
items.answer: Only Team Leads, Support Admins, and Read Only Analysts with export permission can include internal notes. Redaction remains enabled by default.

items.question: What is the maximum CSV import size?
items.answer: The recommended maximum is 25 MB per file or 10,000 rows per import batch.
